name: event_catchup
description: Android-heard packets reach the iPhone directly (route 1). With the link down they go to Android's ring only (ring capacity 5 in this scenario). On relink the iPhone's HB (evtWm) and EVT_SINCE ask for the missing range and Android replays it (flags.replay); the repeated request is skipped. After a longer outage the ring no longer covers the range: EVT_GAP, the iPhone advances its floor and asks again. After an Android service restart (new epoch, empty ring) the old epoch is gone: EVT_GAP with curEpoch, the iPhone asks for the new epoch from 1.
